source.label: Embryon Bally installation and operation manual

strategy.overview: Plunge for the upper-right saucer, then use the upper-right flipper to send the ball through the gate toward the upper-left 1-2 lanes and drop bank. Complete 1-2 and take a lit Bonus X drop to build the end-of-ball collect; hit the upper-right saucer twice to light the left spinner for 1,000 per spin. For Multiball, hit the center captive ball seven times to spell EMBRYON, then shoot the far upper-right saucer to lock the ball and release the replacement.
strategy.simpleOverview: Plunge to the upper-right saucer, then shoot through the gate toward the upper-left 1-2 lanes. Complete 1-2 and collect lit Bonus X awards, and hit the saucer twice to light the left spinner for 1,000 per spin. Hit the center captive ball seven times, then lock at the far upper-right saucer to start Multiball.
strategy.summary: Use the upper-right saucer and flipper to reach the upper-left lanes, build Bonus X, and light the left spinner. Spell EMBRYON at the center captive ball, then lock at the far upper-right saucer for Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Plunge the Saucer
quickInfo.summary: Land in the upper-right saucer and use the upper flipper.

quickInfo.name: Build Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete upper-left 1-2 and take lit awards at the top drops.

quickInfo.name: Light the Spinner
quickInfo.summary: Hit the upper-right saucer twice for 1,000 per spin.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the center captive ball seven times, then lock at the far upper-right saucer.

steps.text: Plunge into the upper-right saucer, then use the upper-right flipper to shoot through the gate toward the upper-left lanes.
Complete the upper-left 1-2 lanes and hit the top drop target when its Bonus X or Collect Bonus lamp is lit.
Hit the upper-right saucer twice to light the left spinner for 1,000 per spin, then repeat the controlled spinner shot.
For Multiball, hit the center captive ball seven times to spell EMBRYON, then shoot the far upper-right saucer to lock the ball and release the replacement.

alternatives.title: Protect the flipsave
alternatives.when: Use this when the A and B return lanes are available.

steps.text: Complete A and B to light the lower-right flipsave, then preserve it for a dangerous captive-ball or spinner rebound.
Raise Bonus X toward 5x while building the held bonus to 59,000.
Take a lit Collect Bonus drop before exposing the ball to another center rebound.

machineSetup: Confirm ball count, Bonus X maximum, Special and Extra Ball conversions, and whether the lower-right flipsave is enabled.
Test the upper-right saucer and flipper, gate, 1-2 lanes, top drops and lamps, left spinner, center captive ball, A-B lanes, and far upper-right lock.

techniques.name: Drop catch
techniques.instruction: Drop-catch a clean saucer or gate feed when it reaches a lower flipper under control.

cautions.issue: Multiball has no separate jackpot or playfield multiplier.
cautions.response: Do not abandon the stronger spinner and bonus route solely to start it.
